description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an inter‑framechain structural block containing cross‑sequenced frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::INTERFRAMECHAIN

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [INTERFRAME-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IF1
    MODE::ALPHA

  [INTERFRAME-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IF2
    MODE::BETA

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    INTERFRAMEBLOCK-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    INTERFRAMEBLOCK-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-INTERFRAMECHAIN}
  R4-Q3-P2-O1

<END-INTERFRAMECHAIN>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire interframechain block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
